description: This openwashdata package publishes water point assessment data collected during routine field monitoring in Malawi in 2023 under Trócaire's water point functionality survey programme, which evaluated the operational status, service reliability and management of rural water supply, mainly boreholes and community-managed water points. The repository read on 2026-09-28 says the data were collected with the mWater platform and include geographic coordinates, functionality status, water availability and reliability indicators, pump and civil works condition, reported mechanical failures, seasonal variability and water quality observations such as salinity and contamination, in 1,425 observations of 45 variables, released as an R data package with CSV and spreadsheet exports under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Coverage is the Malawian districts monitored by the programme. Access is free. Caveats: the sample follows one NGO programme, not a national census of water points, and conditions are observer assessments. It supports service performance and failure analysis of rural water points for resilience studies. Related records: data-openwashdata-malawi-mulanje-post-flood-water-point-survey and data-wpdx-water-point-data-exchange complement it.
